preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 1000 for n in [int(stdin.readline()) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line is an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 1000) representing the number of nodes in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for edges in [[tuple(map(int, stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(n - 1)] for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n - 1 edges, each edge being a pair of distinct integers (u, v) representing connections between nodes.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges for edges in [[tuple(map(int, stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(n - 1)] for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: Each edge (u, v) connects two distinct nodes within the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and isinstance(d, int) for x, d in [query_response.split() for query_response in [stdin.readline().strip() for _ in range(14)]])
preconditions.description: Each query response is a pair of integers (x, d) where x is the node with minimal sum of distances and d is the sum of distances, or (-1, -1) if the query is invalid or exceeded.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c <= n for c in [int(query.split()[1]) for query in [stdout_query.strip() for stdout_query in [stdout.getvalue().split('?')[1:]]]])
preconditions.description: Each query must specify a list of 1 to n distinct nodes.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node <= n for node in [int(node_str) for query in [stdout_query.strip() for stdout_query in [stdout.getvalue().split('?')[1:]]] for node_str in query.split()[2:]] if query.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each node in a query must be within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all('! ' in stdout_query and len(stdout_query.split()) == 3 for stdout_query in [stdout.getvalue().split('!')[1:]] if stdout_query)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the program must output exactly one line starting with '! ' followed by two distinct integers representing the guessed hidden nodes.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= s <= n and 1 <= f <= n and s != f for s, f in [[int(node) for node in stdout_query.split()[1:]] for stdout_query in [stdout.getvalue().split('!')[1:]] if stdout_query])
postconditions.description: The guessed hidden nodes s and f must be distinct and within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all(any((s == hidden_s and f == hidden_f) or (s == hidden_f and f == hidden_s) for hidden_s, hidden_f in [[int(node) for node in test_case.split()[1:2]]]) for s, f in [[int(node) for node in stdout_query.split()[1:]] for stdout_query in [stdout.getvalue().split('!')[1:]] if stdout_query])
postconditions.description: The guessed hidden nodes s and f must exactly match the secret nodes (order does not matter).

postconditions.expression: all(len([query for query in [stdout_query.strip() for stdout_query in [stdout.getvalue().split('?')[1:]]] if query]) <= 14 for _ in range(t))
postconditions.description: The program must not exceed 14 queries per test case.

postconditions.expression: all('? ' in stdout_query and ' ' in stdout_query for stdout_query in [stdout.getvalue().split('?')[1:]] if stdout_query)
postconditions.description: Each query must start with '? ' followed by the number of nodes and the list of nodes.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set([int(node) for node in stdout_query.split()[2:]])) == int(stdout_query.split()[1]) for stdout_query in [stdout.getvalue().split('?')[1:]] if stdout_query)
postconditions.description: Each query must list distinct nodes without repetition.
